notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Wormfang Drake
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering Wormfang Drake's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Wormfang Drake trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
